turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about the zero from his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me, so start with who decided that and when.
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.

Before I came in, a week after the zero went in. What did you tell the vice principal, and is anything about this on Owen's record right now, because if it is, it comes off today or I'm in the principal's office and then in front of the board. I'm writing down that the vice principal heard about this before I did.
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.

Then you'll have her backing in writing, so show me. "Policy is policy," Hale: section 4.2 says you contact me before any mark goes in, and section 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish a concern. Which part of the policy were you following?
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.

"A courtesy." Under 4.2 this meeting is required, Hale, and it was supposed to happen before the zero went in, not a week after. I'm writing that down, and so far I have nothing to take upstairs but your word and a machine's guess.
